title: ocotea indica
intro: Ocotea indica, commonly known as Sandalo, is a plant species that belongs to the Lauraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating pain. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea indica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to protect against oxidative stress and infections. The bioactive constituents present in Ocotea indica include sesquiterpenes, particularly santalol, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and reduce stress.
